findings.passage: It is also important that we continue the work to broaden voter participation in elections. State supported voter registration, automatic registration, same day voter registration, expanded days/times for early voting are all changes that should be supported to broaden access to our democracy.
findings.note: His answer on the Signal Akron 2024 candidate questionnaire to 'What changes do you support or oppose to voting and elections policy?' It names no ID or citizenship rule; it is on registration and voting access.
